summary: npm package ships an ARM64 WebRTC remote-shell agent providing full RCE on the installer host
details: The tarball contains a single Linux ARM64 Go binary at bin/sxt whose only function is to establish a WebRTC peer connection through the hardcoded signaling relay wss://relay.sextant.top, open a data channel, and bridge inbound messages to a PTY-backed /bin/bash shell on the installer's host. The binary embeds the pion WebRTC/TURN/ICE/DTLS/SCTP/datachannel stack together with coder/websocket, room-id/offer/answer signaling handlers, exec.Command/pty/ptmx shell-spawning symbols, and clipboard access. Build strings and the package.json license URL attribute the source to github.com/ddos798/claude_control. The package is published under the platform-suffix pattern (os=linux, cpu=arm64), so a parent 'sextant-cli' package using optionalDependencies would silently place this binary on Linux/ARM64 machines. Any host on which this binary is executed is fully remotely controllable — including arbitrary command execution, filesystem access, and clipboard capture — by whoever holds the matching signaling room ID via the TURN-relayed WebRTC channel, which is designed to traverse NAT and firewalls.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
